spot_price_manipulated.meaning: attacker transiently moved the Uniswap V2 spot tradePrice to an attacker-controlled level before the swap

guard_passed.meaning: the slippage guard passed for the attacker-manipulated tradePrice, so the oracle reported everything inside slippage limits

assumptions: validatePrice is invoked to check the price for a subsequent swap or liquidity action (validate_price_called).
The TWAP guard is intended to derive the time-weighted average from historical cumulative price data rather than the current spot price (intent_twap_guard).

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric slippage-limit threshold or TWAP window, so the guard-pass outcome is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric comparison.
Report does not state who may call validatePrice or whether the attacker is permissionless.

limitations: Only the guard_passes impact is formalized; downstream swap execution, reserve drain, and economic loss are handled in separate passes.
The manipulated spot price is modeled as a Boolean occurrence because no numeric price values are supplied.
